queries.query: "large language model" OR LLM AND (network configuration OR NetOps OR "network operation" OR "network configuration generation") AND (error OR failure OR misconfiguration OR hallucination OR unsafe)
queries.rationale: Identify empirical reports and analyses of LLM-produced network configs and their observed failure modes; foundational phenomenon literature for NetOps-specific LLM errors.

queries.query: (hallucinat* OR fabrication OR "incorrect output" OR "nonsensical command") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "generative model") AND (network OR configuration OR CLI OR router OR switch)
queries.rationale: Capture studies and incident reports that document hallucinations specifically in network command/config contexts (CLI commands, device-specific configs).
source_preferences: operator mailing lists (IETF, NANOG) where incidents are reported

queries.query: ("prompt sensitivity" OR "prompt engineering" OR "prompt robustness" OR "chain-of-thought" OR "reasoning patterns") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (NetOps OR network OR "configuration translation")
queries.rationale: Investigate mechanisms whereby prompts and internal reasoning styles alter NetOps outputs; useful for understanding root causes and intervention points.

queries.query: ("tool-augmented" OR toolformer OR retrieval-augmented OR RAG OR "external verifier" OR "call to tool") AND (LLM OR agent) AND (network OR "NetOps" OR "configuration validator")
queries.rationale: Survey architectures that use external tools or verifiers to improve LLM outputs; assess applicability to network-configuration validation and execution safety.

queries.query: ("generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-then-verify" OR "model+verifier" OR "self-checking" OR "bounded self-correction") AND (network OR configuration OR NetOps OR CLI)
queries.rationale: Find prior methodologies that pair generative models with validators/repairers in NetOps or analogous domains (code/configuration), to ground mitigation strategies.

queries.query: ("formal verification" OR "network verification" OR Batfish OR NetKAT OR VeriFlow OR Anteater) AND (configuration OR policy OR reachability OR loop OR correctness)
queries.rationale: Locate deterministic, formal tools and frameworks for checking network configurations and policies; assess compatibility with LLM-generated artifacts and how they can be integrated into pipelines.

queries.query: ("adversarial" OR attack OR perturbation OR robustness) AND (LLM OR "language model" OR agent) AND (network OR NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Identify adversarial-capability studies that probe LLM robustness in NetOps-like tasks or demonstrate targeted failures from input perturbations; useful for designing stress tests.

queries.query: ("benchmark" OR dataset OR "task suite") AND (NetOps OR "network configuration" OR AIOps OR "LLM for network") AND (6G-Bench OR TSNBench OR OpsEval OR OWL OR similar)
queries.rationale: Collect existing benchmarks and task suites relevant to NetOps and LLM evaluation to evaluate benchmark validity and gaps.

queries.query: ("simulator" OR emulator OR Mininet OR ns-3 OR Emulab OR DETER) AND (network OR NetOps OR "execution environment") AND (validation OR "runtime test" OR fidelity)
queries.rationale: Survey execution/evaluation environments used to test configuration correctness and operational effects; assess fidelity limits for using simulators to validate LLM outputs.

queries.query: ("evaluation metric" OR "scoring" OR "correctness metric" OR "operational validity" OR calibration OR "uncertainty estimation") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (configuration OR NetOps OR policy)
queries.rationale: Find metrics and evaluation methodologies used to quantify correctness, reliability, and calibration of generative outputs in operational domains; guide metric selection and threats-to-validity.

queries.query: ("human-in-the-loop" OR HITL OR "operator-in-the-loop" OR "reviewer" OR "approval workflow") AND (NetOps OR network OR configuration) AND (automation OR agent OR LLM)
queries.rationale: Collect work on mixed-initiative workflows and human oversight for automated NetOps changes, to compare mitigations and define realistic baselines.
source_preferences: HCI and systems conferences (CHI, CSCW, OSDI)

queries.query: ("LLM for code" OR Codex OR AlphaCode OR program synthesis OR "code generation") AND (verification OR "unit test" OR static analysis OR "test oracle")
queries.rationale: Neighboring literature from code generation and program synthesis offers parallels (synthesis+verification, test generation) that can transfer methods for verifying network configs.

queries.query: ("AIOps" OR "AI for IT operations" OR "AI for network operations" OR "autonomous network management") AND (survey OR review OR "systematic review")
queries.rationale: Gather surveys and broad-positioning papers to situate the program in the wider AIOps/NetOps landscape and identify common evaluation pitfalls and open problems.

inclusion_criteria: English-language primary sources (peer-reviewed papers, arXiv preprints, technical reports)
Empirical or methodological work addressing LLMs/agents applied to NetOps, network configuration, or closely analogous domains (code generation, program synthesis)
Benchmarks, datasets, and simulators with publicly available artifacts or clear reproducibility guidance
Works describing or evaluating validators, formal-verification tools, or deterministic network-analysis tools (e.g., Batfish, NetKAT)
Papers on LLM failure modes, hallucination, prompt sensitivity, tool augmentation, and self-correction relevant to operational outputs
Human-in-the-loop or mixed-initiative NetOps workflows with empirical evaluation
Security/robustness studies that perform adversarial or perturbation testing on generative agents
Surveys or position papers that summarize AIOps/NetOps AI trends and open problems
exclusion_criteria: Pure marketing materials, blog posts, or press releases without empirical data or reproducible artifacts (unless operator mailing-list posts document verifiable incidents)
Papers wholly unrelated to network operations (e.g., purely biomedical LLM studies) unless they offer directly transferable verification/mitigation techniques
Proprietary datasets or private testbed results not publicly accessible (can be noted but not used as core evidence)
Works prior to ~2005 except for foundational networking or formal-verification theory that remain directly cited for theoretical grounding
Non-English sources without an English translation (unless essential and accessible)
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from ~2019–2026 for LLM-era methods, robustness studies, and benchmarks; include earlier foundational networking verification and formal-methods work (2000–2018) where directly relevant. The 2019+ window captures transformer-era LLMs, tool-augmented agents, and recent AIOps/NetOps experiments while allowing foundational verifier literature that predates LLMs.
